connector.name: ITM Platform
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI assistants to ITM Platform projects, tasks, budgets, risks, and team workload.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.itmplatform.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the itmplatform account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
